description: Maintenance personnel are not properly authorized, escorted when required, or designated with appropriate access levels.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing maintenance personnel authorization lists, absence of escort procedures for uncleared personnel, lack of access authorization verification processes, and no designated supervisors for maintenance activities.
